items.mainDefect: The downsize loop checks `tempfile.size`, which reads the size from an open file handle that goes stale once ImageOptim replaces the file, so the loop never sees the file shrink and always runs all 5 passes.

secondary.defect: `Upload.create_for` receives the stale `tempfile.size`, so the stored upload filesize (and possibly width/height) doesn't match the image actually stored.

items.mainDefect: The client-side upload size check is hardcoded to 10MB instead of using the per-type site setting, so it no longer matches the limit the server enforces.

secondary.defect: The 'file too large' message in the 413 handler is hardcoded to 10MB, so it tells users a limit that isn't the one actually enforced.

items.mainDefect: Five fixed 80% downsize passes can't bring large images under `max_image_size_kb`, so oversized files still reach `Upload.create_for` and get rejected.

secondary.defect: The loop ignores the `false` that `OptimizedImage.downsize` returns when convert fails, so it uses up all its attempts and submits the untouched original.

items.mainDefect: The client hardcodes a 10MB limit in the size check and the 413 handler, disconnecting it from the `max_image_size_kb` and `max_attachment_size_kb` site settings.

secondary.defect: The server-side `FileHelper.download` cap in `uploads_controller.rb` is also fixed at 10 megabytes instead of following the site setting.
